newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle at $112.50/dressed, slow-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle at $112.50/dressed, slow-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold in light volume at $112.50 per cwt on a dressed basis, up $0.50 from Tuesday's top, market sources said.
About 1,500 head sold at the higher level, but most showlists were sold out following Tuesday's active sales, they said. An estimates 70,000 head have sold for the week, the sources said.
On a live basis, cattle sold at $70.00 in western Nebraska, but volume was light because there was not much left to sell, the market sources said.
